Hi Jamie — really glad there's interest from your VPs. Quick read-through and two concrete options:

Option B: Monday 29 Mar, 10:30 AM ET / 15:30 CET (45 mins) — slightly later for US execs, still within their morning.

One important note: the EU daylight-saving change occurs on Sunday 28 Mar. That means the local CET team will shift from CET (UTC+1) to CEST (UTC+2) overnight, and some calendar clients can show the meeting one hour earlier if invites are created before the switch. To avoid the classic "clockflip" confusion:
- I will create the invite after the change (we'll send it on Sunday evening UTC) so all attendees see the same absolute UTC time.
- Alternatively, we can pick a slot that is more resilient (e.g., 11:00 ET) but I know your execs prefer earlier.

I've attached a short agenda for the 45-minute run (demo-agenda-v2.pdf). If either option works for your VPs, reply with A or B and I'll send a confirmed invite with the Zoom link.
